title: Santa Monica Police: Blue Notebook Review  | Crime Stats & The "Red Notebook"
description:
Sgt. Rick is back with the latest updates from the Santa Monica Police Department. In this episode, our NROs (Neighborhood Resource Officers) break down the latest stats and success stories from across the city.

In this episode:
Stats (0:10): Year-to-date arrest numbers and trends.
Beat 1 (0:56): Officer Hollowell on SMART Center technology and beach arrests.
Beat 2 (3:21): Officer Pardo discusses traffic enforcement and the high cost of DUIs.
Beat 3 (4:44): Officer Tago covers the HLP team and illegal firearm seizures.
Beat 4 (5:58): Officer Avila on community engagement and senior services.
The Bloopers (8:01): What happens when the cameras keep rolling... and the debut of the "Red Notebook Review."

Stay safe, Santa Monica!
